rows.label: Basic tariff: taxable income above CHF 433,500
rows.value: 5% of the whole income

sections.title: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer (Schwyz)

rows.label: Property tax (Liegenschaftssteuer)
rows.value: None: the canton and its municipalities levy no property tax

source.title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026)

sections.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).

sections.title: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer (Schwyz)

rows.label: Property transfer tax (Handänderungssteuer)
rows.value: None as such: only land registry or transfer fees are charged (amounts not stored)

source.title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026)

sections.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.

sections.title: Wealth tax (Schwyz): simple tax tariff 2026

rows.label: Simple tax
rows.value: 0.6‰ of taxable wealth, proportional

rows.label: Deductions from net wealth
rows.value: CHF 250,000 for married couples; CHF 125,000 for others; CHF 30,000 per child

source.title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Schwyz (Stand Februar 2026), Vermögenssteuer: Steuerberechnung

sections.note: The simple tax is multiplied by the cantonal and communal multipliers on this page (and church tax for members) unless the tariff states the tax itself; ESTV Kantonsblatt, Stand Februar 2026.
